themes.mechanism: A .dark class on <html>, chosen from the account menu and stored per browser (src/lib/theme.ts).

matched-tint.note: Rendered as bg-primary/[0.06]; hex is the light-theme composite.

display.purpose: Landing hero headline only; 2.25rem phones, 3rem sm, 3.25rem lg.

headline.purpose: Landing section headings (1.5rem) and closing call to action (1.875rem).

title.purpose: The one h1 per app page, via PageHeader.

subtitle.purpose: In-page section headings, rule names, button labels.

lead.purpose: The line under a landing heading.

body.purpose: App text, table cells, rule sentences; inputs go to 16px below md.

label.purpose: Breadcrumbs, decision and status chip words, section descriptions.

caption.purpose: Column headers, hints, Matched / Not reached labels, metadata.

mono.purpose: Keys, values, JSON, endpoint paths and code only.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.value: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Popovers, selects, dropdown menus, token pickers.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Sheets, dialogs, and a rule while dragged.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and width transitions (rule tint, sidebar collapse). No bounce.

motion.name: skipped-dim

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #4f46e5); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #4f46e5) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #4f46e5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #4f46e5) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions in headers and rows.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #f4f4f5); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #4f46e5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #4f46e5) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); font: 400 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #4f46e5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #4f46e5) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Decision Chip
components.description: The only way an outcome is shown: a coloured dot plus the word.
components.html: Allowed Denied
components.css: .ds-decision { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 16px; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-allow { color: var(--success, #15803d); } .ds-deny { color: var(--danger, #dc2626); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Policy status: dot in the status colour, word in ink.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 16px; color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Rule Rows
components.description: Rules as divided sentences; the matched one tinted with a Matched label, later ones dimmed as Not reached.
components.html:
1. 1When Customer tier is gold, allow with 15% discountMatched
  2. 2When First order is yes, allow with 10% discountNot reached
components.css: .ds-rules { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 560px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); font: 400 14px/1.6 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); } .ds-rule { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-rule + .ds-rule { border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); } .ds-rule-n { font: 400 12px/1.8 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-rule-tag { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-rule-matched { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #4f46e5) 6%, transparent); } .ds-rule-matched .ds-rule-tag { color: var(--primary, #4f46e5); font-weight: 500; } .ds-rule-skipped { color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-rule-skipped .ds-rule-text { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-token { font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline dotted color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, #71717a) 60%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Sentence Token
components.description: A variable word in a rule sentence that opens a picker.
components.css: .ds-sentence { font: 400 14px/1.6 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); } .ds-token-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline dotted color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, #71717a) 60%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-token-btn:hover { background: var(--muted, #f4f4f5); } .ds-token-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #4f46e5) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: 240px off-white sidebar; active item takes the sidebar accent fill.
components.html: HomePoliciesActivityConnect
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 240px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar, #fafafa); border-right: 1px solid var(--sidebar-border, #e4e4e7); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #f0f0f2); color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); } .ds-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #f0f0f2); color: var(--foreground, #0a0a0b); }

narrative.overview:
PengOPA is the category-standard SaaS look executed at the precision of Linear, Vercel and Clerk: a white ground, near-black ink, a cool zinc grey scale and one indigo accent. The world has no theme or motif; its character comes from what it refuses. Sections are not boxed as bordered cards on a grey canvas. Structure is drawn with 1px dividers and spacing, and the one place the accent carries meaning beyond action is the matched rule, where a decision shows the path it took.

The signature grammar is shared by the app and the landing page: rules are written as sentences with inline dotted-underline tokens, a run marks the rule that matched with a faint indigo tint and the word "Matched", and the rules it never reached are dimmed. Allow and Deny are never filled pills; they are a coloured dot followed by the word. Density is working-tool density (13 to 14px UI type, 32px rows and controls) without the grey, gridded look of enterprise software.

Light is the default theme. Dark is opt-in from the account menu (light, dark or system), stored per browser and applied with a `.dark` class on the root.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, cool zinc neutrals, one indigo accent
Structure from 1px dividers and spacing, not nested cards
Allow/Deny as a coloured dot plus a word
Matched rule: 6% primary tint plus a "Matched" label; skipped rules dimmed "Not reached"
Geist for everything, Geist Mono only for keys, values and code
32px controls and table rows; 6 to 8px radius

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo means action, focus, selection or "this rule matched". It never means allow, deny or status.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber are reserved for decision outcome and policy status. They are never used as decorative category colours.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for keys, values, paths and code. Headings, labels, buttons and prose are always Geist.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tables and anything marked `data-numeric` use tabular figures so numbers align in columns.

rules.name: The Divider Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by a 1px rule and space. If a block would need a border on all four sides to read as a group, the layout is wrong first.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element is above the page (menu, sheet, dialog, drag). Nothing sitting in the page flow gets one.

rules.name: The No-Bar Rule
rules.body: No coloured side stripe wider than 1px on any row, card or callout. Emphasis is a tint plus a word.

dos: Do show every outcome with DecisionChip: a 6px coloured dot plus the word Allowed or Denied.
Do mark the matched rule with the 6% primary tint and a "Matched" label, and dim the rules it skipped as "Not reached".
Do build structure from 1px dividers and spacing; group with a divider and a heading.
Do keep one primary (indigo) button per view.
Do use Geist Mono only for keys, values, paths and code.
Do design and check light first; dark is opt-in and must hold the same rules.
Do keep tables and controls at 32px, growing to 44px on touch.
donts: Don't render Allow or Deny as filled pills or badges.
Don't use a coloured side bar wider than 1px to mark a matched, selected or warning row.
Don't nest cards inside cards or box every section on a grey canvas.
Don't add eyebrows or kicker labels above headings, sparklines, or icons in tinted tiles.
Don't use indigo to mean allow, deny or status.
Don't put shadows on in-page surfaces.
Don't use mono for headings, buttons or prose.
